story.title: Scott Bessent Seeks Clarity from Nvidia on Chip Sales to China Amid Scandal
story.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has called for Nvidia to provide answers regarding its sales of AI chips to China, particularly in light of concerns over compliance with export controls. Bessent indicated that the government is investigating whether there were 'malicious actors' within the company responsible for any noncompliance. He also mentioned that the Trump administration has been in contact with Nvidia's leadership regarding the ongoing issues related to former CEO Jensen Huang.

related_stories.title: Suspected Drone Strike on Russian Ship in Benghazi Raises Security Concerns
related_stories.summary: A Russian warship, the Merkury, was reportedly struck by a suspected Ukrainian drone while docked at the naval base in Benghazi, Libya. The explosion caused significant damage to the vessel and ignited a fire at the facility. Local officials indicated that the ship was in Libya for fuel and supplies on its return journey to Russia. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack, which raises concerns about the implications for regional security amid the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict.

related_stories.title: Russian Strike on Apartment Building Near Kyiv Leaves Casualties and Trapped Residents
related_stories.summary: A Russian strike on an apartment building in Dymer, north of Kyiv, resulted in at least two confirmed deaths and several injuries. Nine individuals, including a child, were evacuated, while up to seven others are feared trapped under the rubble. Rescue operations are ongoing as authorities search for survivors in the collapsed structure.

related_stories.title: Trump Directs Contractors to Withhold Information from Congress
related_stories.summary: President Trump has issued an executive order instructing federal contractors to consult with the White House before responding to inquiries from Congress. The order mandates that any communications deemed 'privileged' by the administration should be withheld from Congress. This move is seen as a response to anticipated oversight efforts from Democrats set to take control of Congress in January.

related_stories.title: Israeli Opposition Leader Condemns Attacks on Palestinian Villages as 'Jewish Terrorism'
related_stories.summary: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has condemned a series of arson attacks on Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank, labeling them as 'Jewish terrorism.' The attacks involved Israeli settlers setting fire to vehicles and properties in multiple locations. In response, Israeli authorities have initiated an investigation into the incidents.
